title: LiteLang Ability and Feature Showcase
description: Six-chapter, eighteen-topic verified curriculum teaching LiteLang capabilities and core modules from foundations to closures and module APIs.

chapters.title: Foundations: Bindings, Numbers, and Unicode Text
chapters.summary: Immutable := defaults, zero/reserved initialization, var updates, checked numbers, and UTF-8 scalar text.

topics.title: Bindings, Zero Defaults, Reserved Storage, and Mutability
topics.summary: Uses := bindings, omitted zero-value defaults, reserved ? first-initialization, and explicit var reassignment/compound updates.

topics.title: Integers, Floats, Division Families, Narrow Widths, and Power
topics.summary: Contrasts truncating / and % with floor :/ and :%, demonstrates exact Float contexts, Int8/Int16/Int32/Float32 widths, and right-associative **.

topics.title: Escapes, Code-Point Text Operations, and UTF-8 Conversion
topics.summary: Applies string escapes, core/text trimming and code-point indexing, and core/unicode scalar and strict UTF-8 round-trips.

chapters.title: Control Flow, Loops, and Structured Cleanup
chapters.summary: Expression conditionals, comparison chains, subjectless match, loop accumulators, labeled @tag exits, and LIFO finally cleanup.

topics.title: Value Conditionals, Chained Comparisons, and Subjectless Match
topics.summary: Combines single-evaluation comparison chains with expression if/else, partial conditional statements, and ordered Boolean match arms.

topics.title: Conditional & Sequence Loops, Metadata, Break Payloads, and Then
topics.summary: Demonstrates conditional action loops, sequence loop .value/.index/.count metadata, break value payloads, and then completion clauses.

topics.title: Labeled @tag Transfers and LIFO Finally Cleanup
topics.summary: Shows labeled @tag block returns, multi-loop continue/break targeting, @tag.value in then clauses, and guaranteed LIFO finally execution.

chapters.title: Data Shapes, Collections, and Type Aliases
chapters.summary: Tuples, shorthand labels, fixed arrays vs mutable lists, transparent type aliases, and inner lexical type scopes.

topics.title: Tuples, Shorthand Labels, Label Conversion, and Destructuring
topics.summary: Covers unnamed/named/singleton/mixed tuples, =name shorthand, explicit label relabeling, and var tuple destructuring.

topics.title: Fixed [T; N] Arrays vs Mutable List<T> Snapshots
topics.summary: Contrasts fixed-extent arrays with growable mut and var mut lists, push_front/push_back/pop_front/pop_back, and value snapshots.

topics.title: Transparent Type Aliases Across Root and Inner Blocks
topics.summary: Defines transparent root and inner-block type aliases with forward inner alias resolution and outer alias preservation after shadowing.

chapters.title: The Unified Block Model and Execution Trace
chapters.summary: Value vs statement blocks, dead-code pruning, parallel symbol wiring, 4-level shadowing, and compile-time trace safety.

topics.title: Value Blocks, Final-Item Rule, Scopes, and Dead-Code Pruning
topics.summary: Demonstrates expression-yielding blocks vs Unit-tail statement blocks, pure dead-code elimination, and retention of side effects.

topics.title: Parallel Compile-Time Symbol Wiring and Nearer-Forward Shadowing
topics.summary: Shows root and inner forward references, mutual recursion, direct own-name recursion, 4-level nearer-forward precedence, and eager outer reads.

topics.title: Compile-Time Wiring vs Runtime Execution Trace Safety
topics.summary: Explains valid runtime ordering past reserved ? variables, write-before-read inside closures, and list-queued deferred functions.

chapters.title: Functions, Higher-Order Pipelines, and Lexical Closures
chapters.summary: Named calls, self recursion, explicit io.exit termination, callable types, contextual inference, and capturing stateful closures.

topics.title: Named/Shorthand Calls, Self Recursion, and Early Exit
topics.summary: Teaches positional/named/=name call syntax, positional and named self(...) recursion, script args, and explicit io.exit error helpers.

topics.title: Callable Types, Contextual Inference, and Function Dispatch
topics.summary: Builds map/filter/fold combinators using fn(...) type aliases, omitted-type lambda inference, and List<fn> dispatch pipelines.

topics.title: Lexical Closures Capturing State, Lists, Loop Items, and Frames
topics.summary: Demonstrates escaping makeCounter frames, captured mut List mutations across scopes, and per-iteration loop item captures.

chapters.title: Modules and Core Standard Utilities
chapters.summary: Module visibility boundaries, path/file operations with finally cleanup, deterministic crypto, formatting, and host/time checks.

topics.title: Namespace Imports, pub Contracts, and Private Module Helpers
topics.summary: Imports a sibling module exposing pub type aliases, pub constants, and pub functions while hiding private helpers.

topics.title: Path Normalization, Temp Workspaces, File I/O, and Finally Cleanup
topics.summary: Uses core/path, core/file temp workspaces, aligned core/format output, and finally directory removal with deterministic output.

topics.title: Cryptographic Digests, Encodings, and Host/Clock Invariants
topics.summary: Computes SHA-256 and HMAC-SHA256 digests, round-trips Hex and Base64, and checks monotonic clock and process invariants.
